messages:
Priya (SRE): Following the DR postmortem, creating a short thread for owners + acceptance criteria. Keep replies as: owner | ETA (date) | done condition.

Noah (Net): I'll take routing & BGP fallback validation.

Priya (SRE): List: 1) BGP failover harness + canary; 2) daily snapshot restore into staging; 3) restore runbook: add KV priming + traffic gate; 4) quarterly game-day schedule + war-room; 5) recurring-incident feed to triage board.

Noah (Net): 1) Noah | 2026-04-07 | canary run that simulates region fail and shows failover within 30s for test prefix. Blocker: test prefix in eu-west.

Rina (Backups): 2) Rina | 2026-04-03 | automated daily restore job with pass/fail metric and sample data verification. Blocker: object-store read latency in eu-west (ticket INC-8582).

Tobias (Oncall): 3) Tobias | 2026-03-30 | runbook PR with explicit KV priming step + checklist for traffic-shift toggles. Will add synthetic warmup snippet.

Sam (Platform PM): 4) Sam | 2026-04-15 | calendar + war-room template live, invites sent. DONE when runbook link is embedded and attendees confirmed.

Priya (SRE): 5) Priya | 2 sprints | recurrence feed MVP: dashboard + weekly digest to triage.

Noah (Net): sample canary command:

```
# fail eu-west and validate routing fallback
./bgp-canary --prefix test-eu --fail-region eu-west-1 --expect-redirect 30s --dry-run
```

Rina (Backups): restore cron example:

```
# daily restore at 03:00 UTC
0 3 * * * /opt/redwood/bin/restore --snapshot latest --cluster=staging --verify checksums --notify onfail
```

Tobias (Oncall): KV priming plan: synthetic requests hitting top-10 hot keys for 10m after restore; add TTL 48h in staging.

Sam (Platform PM): war-room template: agenda, owner list, roll-forward/rollback decision tree. I'll attach in the follow-up doc.

Priya (SRE): ops rules: tag PRs with `dr-postmortem-2026` and include owner | ETA | rollback plan | test plan in body. I'll spot-check before approvals.

Noah (Net): created NET-3190 for test prefix and ACLs. Link: https://issues.redwood/NET-3190.

Rina (Backups): opened BACK-214 for eu-west object-store latency; linked INC-8582.

Tobias (Oncall): created PR for runbook updates: https://git.redwood/repo/runbooks/PR-4271. reviewers: Priya, Lee.

Sam (Platform PM): created calendar stub: "DR Game Day - warm standby drill" 2026-04-15. sharing runbook link in invite.

Priya (SRE): OpsBot: set a weekly reminder for owners to update follow-up sheet on Fridays.

OpsBot: Reminder created: channel=#incidents, cadence=weekly, day=Fri, time=16:00 UTC, tag=dr-followups.

Noah (Net): canary harness PR open: https://git.redwood/repo/net/PR-4189 (WIP).

Rina (Backups): ran first daily restore in staging; checksum mismatch for snapshot 2026-03-25. Logged in BACK-214.

Priya (SRE): OK — Rina, please add minimal repro steps for the failing restore. We'll triage Monday 09:00 PT.

Sam (Platform PM): I'll add micro-sprint slides for the ops review with status, ETA, and blockers.

Priya (SRE): thanks all. update the shared sheet when you open PRs/tickets: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DR-FOLLOWUP (internal). Reopen thread if escalation needed. :white_check_mark:
